name: 14224 · West Seneca, NY
findings: ZIP 14224 (West Seneca) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14224 (West Seneca) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
